#501 · Sea Otter Pokémon

Oshawott

Water

Unova · Generation 5

Oshawott is a Water-type Sea Otter Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 5.9 kg. It evolves into Dewott. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (63), with a base stat total of 308.
